caseNameFull: Derek Carder, Mark Bolleter, Drew Daugherty, and Andrew Kissinger, on Behalf of Themselves and All Others Similarly Situated v. Continental Airlines, Inc.

opinions.text:
Motion of John Marshall Law School Veterans Legal Support Center & Clinic, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.

Same case below, 636 F.3d 172.
